claims.evidence_quote: Examinations showing at least one polyp or carcinoma 5 mm or larger were considered to have positive results. For combined readings, results were considered positive if either of the two interpreters reported finding a polyp or carcinoma.
claims.explanation: The evidence supports that double reading of barium enemas was studied and that combined readings were considered positive when either interpreter reported a polyp or carcinoma, but it does not establish that double reading is necessary to detect them.
